sloka: अनुसृप्तस्तदा काको जगाम विविधां गतिम् ।लोककाम इमं लोकं सर्वं वै विचचार ह ।। ५.३८.३२।।।।
transliteration: anusṛptastadā kāko jagāma vividhāṁ gatim ।lokakāma imaṁ lokaṁ sarvaṁ vai vicacāra ha ।। 5.38.32।।।।

translations.english: 'Then that crow flew to many places seeking asylum all over the universe chased by the blade of grass.
